name: Halo Executive Desk
description: Bring a luxury corporate look to your workspace with the Executive Halo Desk. This sleek modern desk features a wide futuristic tabletop, smooth cream and charcoal panels and a bold sculpted base. Perfect for luxury offices, business rooms, modern study rooms, and professional workspace builds.
